definitions.explanation: The degree to which something is wide or spacious.
The measurement of how wide something is.

examples.japanese: この{部屋|へや}の{広|ひろ}さはどのくらいですか。
{公園|こうえん}の{広|ひろ}さに{驚|おどろ}いた。
examples.english: I was surprised by how spacious the park was.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{知識|ちしき}の{広|ひろ}さには{感心|かんしん}する。
examples.english: I am impressed by the breadth of his knowledge.

notes:
{広|ひろ}さ is the noun form of the adjective {広|ひろ}い (wide, spacious), created with the suffix ～さ.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～の{広|ひろ}さ (the size/extent of ~)
- {広|ひろ}さは～{平方|へいほう}メートル (~ square meters in area)
- {広|ひろ}さに{驚|おどろ}く (to be surprised by the spaciousness)

MEASUREMENT USAGE:
When asking about room/area size in Japan:
- この{部屋|へや}の{広|ひろ}さは？ (How big is this room?)
- {広|ひろ}さは20{畳|じょう}です (It's 20 tatami mats in size)

FIGURATIVE USAGE:
{広|ひろ}さ can describe abstract breadth:
- {心|こころ}の{広|ひろ}さ (broadmindedness)
- {知識|ちしき}の{広|ひろ}さ (breadth of knowledge)

RELATED MEASUREMENTS:
- {面積|めんせき}: Area (more technical/precise)
- {大|おお}きさ: Size (more general)
